announcements_expiry_after_publication_c.name: announcements_expiry_after_publication_check
announcements_expiry_after_publication_c.value: "announcements"."expires_at" is null or "announcements"."published_at" is null or "announcements"."expires_at" > "announcements"."published_at"

canteen_dish_votes_identity_chk.name: canteen_dish_votes_identity_chk
canteen_dish_votes_identity_chk.value:
(
        ("canteen_dish_votes"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "canteen_dish_votes"."anonymous_session_id" IS NULL) OR
        ("canteen_dish_votes"."user_id" IS NULL AND "canteen_dish_votes"."anonymous_session_id" IS NOT NULL)
      )

canteen_menu_items_external_identity_uid.name: canteen_menu_items_external_identity_uidx
canteen_menu_items_external_identity_uid.where: "canteen_menu_items"."external_source" is not null and "canteen_menu_items"."external_key" is not null

canteen_shame_votes_identity_chk.name: canteen_shame_votes_identity_chk
canteen_shame_votes_identity_chk.value:
(
        ("canteen_shame_votes"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "canteen_shame_votes"."anonymous_session_id" IS NULL) OR
        ("canteen_shame_votes"."user_id" IS NULL AND "canteen_shame_votes"."anonymous_session_id" IS NOT NULL)
      )

notifications_announcement_identity_chec.name: notifications_announcement_identity_check
notifications_announcement_identity_chec.value: ("notifications"."kind" = 'announcement_published' and "notifications"."announcement_id" is not null) or ("notifications"."kind" <> 'announcement_published' and "notifications"."announcement_id" is null)
